newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Delhaize sees 96 cons profit up 15-20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Delhaize sees 96 cons profit up 15-20 pct.

text.p: Belgian retailer Etablissements Delhaize Freres et Cie "Le Lion" SA said on Friday in a statement it expected consolidated profit to be 15 to 20 percent higher in 1996 than in the previous year.
It also expected to pay a higher dividend.
"The growth of the Delhaize "Le Lion" group will continue in 1997 thanks to the opening of more than 200 sales outlets," it added.
In 1995 Delhaize made a group net profit of 3.77 billion Belgian francs and consolidated profit of 6.81 billion francs.
Net dividend on 1995 earnings was 25 francs a share.
